interpretation.boundary: False positives here refute only these simple checked selector forms.  They do not refute every possible arithmetic selector or any complement/lower-support rescue theorem.
interpretation.falsifier: A selector is falsified on the checked rows when it selects a near-boundary row but also selects safer rows outside the same near-boundary band.
interpretation.mechanism_tested: Treat the frozen full-stage above-floor tiny margins as near-boundary events and test whether simple selectors such as q286 residue or scalar residual intervals isolate them.
interpretation.next_theorem: A viable selector theorem must use finer actual prime-pair distribution than q286 residue alone or a single scalar residual interval, or it must be replaced by a signed aggregate theorem.
